title: Paystride Payroll Card Program Monthly Fee Schedule
content:
## Monthly fees by package

The Paystride Payroll Card Program bills two monthly fees to the employer's program funding account: a flat monthly program fee, and a monthly fee for each active card. An active card is a card with at least one payroll load posted in the month. Monthly fees are debited from the funding balance on the fifth business day of the following month.

| Package | Monthly program fee (USD per month) | Active card fee (USD per active card per month) | Business day of the following month on which monthly fees are debited |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 0.00 | 0.00 | 5 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 49.00 | 0.00 | 5 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 99.00 | 0.25 | 5 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 199.00 | 0.45 | 5 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 399.00 | 0.65 | 5 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 799.00 | 0.95 | 5 |

### Notes to the schedule

- The figures are those of the package the employer holds; each row applies only to programs held in that package.
- The Essential package carries no monthly program fee and no active card fee, and the Standard package carries a monthly program fee but no active card fee.
- A card counts as active for a month only through a payroll load posted in that month; the schedule states the fee per such card.

### Reading the schedule (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical program held in the Advantage package with 120 active cards in a month is billed, for that month, the monthly program fee of 199.00 and an active card fee of 0.45 for each of the 120 active cards, that is 54.00 for the active cards. The same 120 active cards under the Standard package carry no active card fee.
